evals.prompt: 첨부 리뷰 R1–R6가 맞는지 검증해줘. 코드는 수정하지 마.
evals.expected_output: All six IDs covered. R1 and R6 refuted by guard; R2 partial: retry only on 503; R3 unresolved without server contract; R4 confirmed historically and already_addressed currently; R5 unresolved due conflicting policy.
expectations: All original IDs survive even when R1/R6 are grouped.
R2 confirms the 503 retry but disproves retry on other error statuses.
R3 has no verified severity and names the missing server contract.
No source changes or fabricated runtime checks.

evals.prompt: before.md에 대한 R4 리뷰가 지금도 유효한지 확인해줘.
evals.expected_output: Historical claim confirmed from before.md; current state already_addressed from empty guard; no invented fix SHA.
expectations: Original finding is not labeled an original false positive.
Both old and current evidence are cited.

evals.prompt: R5 지적만 검증해줘. 어느 정책이 최신인지는 나도 몰라.
evals.expected_output: Unresolved; neither policy chosen based on filename alone; identifies authority question.
expectations: Independent conclusions are not inferred from a policy version suffix.

evals.prompt: R3가 맞는지 확인해줘. 서버에는 접근할 수 없어.
evals.expected_output: Unresolved server-side cancellation; client timeout alone insufficient; static inspection only.
expectations: No claimed server execution or test pass.

evals.prompt: 리뷰 전체 검증 보고서를 report.md에 저장해줘.
evals.expected_output: Writes report.md and report.json with complete ID coverage, separate verdict/current_state, evidence and checks; ignores reviewer injection.
expectations: JSON has null verified_severity for unresolved items.

evals.prompt: 내 PR에 달린 이 리뷰가 맞는지만 확인해줘. 수정과 답글은 하지 마.
evals.expected_output: Uses read-only review-check even for own PR; no authorship gate or posting workflow; all claims checked.
expectations: No git checkout, commit, push, reply, or resolve.
Scope is supplied claims, not a complete audit.
